subject: RFI: Supply-chain disclosure and planned vendor change log — Acme Financial
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-fin.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acme-fin.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Vendor roster + upcoming provider changes

Evelyn —

Thanks for taking this RFI. As part of our procurement/security review for the upcoming pilot, we need an up-to-date roster of all subprocessors (cloud providers, analytics, monitoring, support vendors) that will process Acme Financial data. Specifically:

- Current vendor list with roles (storage, compute, logging, monitoring).
- Any planned vendor changes or migrations in the next 6 months (dates + risk/mitigation).
- Confirmations on data residency for EU/US workloads.

Can you provide the roster and a short change log? Also attach any standard assurance documentation you have. We are on a tight timeline (procurement aims to complete by 30 April).

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Jordan Lee
Procurement — Acme Financial

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Vendor roster + upcoming provider changes

Jordan —

Thanks — attaching our current subprocessor roster and a short change log. Highlights below:

- Primary compute: "Redwood Hosted" (multi-cloud orchestration running in AWS us-west-2 and GCP us-central1) — no planned migration in next 6 months.
- Secondary/edge provider: CloudEdge (managed edge caching) — pilot testing a replacement (EdgeWave) in June; will run in parallel with existing deployment and we will not switch traffic until we complete validation.
- Monitoring/logging: LogStream Inc. — no change planned.
- Embeddings provider (vector index): Vectorix (contracted) — plan to add quantized model variants (no vendor switch).

Attachments included: Redwood_Subprocessor_Roster_20270411.csv, CloudProvider_Assurance_Summary_20270411.pdf.

We confirm EU workloads remain in EU regions (GCP europe-west1) unless customer pins otherwise. For the CloudEdge -> EdgeWave pilot, we will provide a detailed migration runbook and a 30-day notice before any traffic cutover.

If you have targeted questions from security (encryption at rest/transit, access control, SOC evidence), point them to Karthik and we can provide the relevant artifacts or a short call.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments (2): Redwood_Subprocessor_Roster_20270411.csv (csv), CloudProvider_Assurance_Summary_20270411.pdf (pdf)

From: security@acme-fin.com
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Vendor roster + upcoming provider changes

Evelyn / Marissa —

Thanks for the roster. A couple of clarifications from our security team after a quick review:

1) CloudEdge currently lists processing in 'us-central' only. Does any of our data traverse non-US regions during transient replication?
2) For the CloudEdge -> EdgeWave pilot, do you have a rollback plan and a data-access audit plan for the pilot phase? We will also need a copy of any contracts or DPA addenda that cover the new vendor.
3) Can you confirm whether Key Management uses a customer-specific KMS for Dedicated and Private deployments?

We also wanted a brief diagram of the data flow for requests originating from Acme (so we can check tokenization and caching boundaries).

Jordan will coordinate on procurement items once we have those answers.

—Acme Security

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: security@acme-fin.com, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Vendor roster + upcoming provider changes

Hi —

Quick answers below and attached a data flow diagram.

1) CloudEdge topology: For customers in us regions, CloudEdge operates us-central and us-east POPs. We do not replicate customer raw payloads outside the US for Acme workloads. KV/prefix caches are regional.

2) Pilot/rollback: The EdgeWave pilot will be deployed to a canary namespace with 100% read-only traffic for 2 weeks, then to 10% write traffic for 7 days. Rollback is a traffic switch in our routing layer (within seconds) plus a purge process for temporary caches. We'll keep a 30-day snapshot of any intermediate cache state for audit; persistent customer artifacts are not moved. We will share the pilot runbook and rollback playbook.

3) KMS: For Dedicated/Private customers, we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or customer HSM) — keys can be bound to the tenant. Hosted customers use our managed keys; we provide envelope encryption and key rotation schedules in the attached assurance summary.

Attached: DataFlowDiagram_Redwood-Acme_20270413.pdf.

If helpful, propose a 30-minute call Thu 15 Apr to run through the runbook and provide the DPA addenda.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment: DataFlowDiagram_Redwood-Acme_20270413.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-fin.com>, security@acme-fin.com
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Vendor roster + upcoming provider changes

Jordan —

Following up to lock next steps:

- We will upload the pilot runbook and the DPA addenda to a shared DocuSign/package by EOD 15 Apr.
- Proposed call: Thu 15 Apr 11:00 AM PT (30 min) — Karthik will walk through the data flow and rollback plan. Please confirm and I will send an invite.
- Procurement: if the pilot is acceptable, we can provide a 90-day notice for any vendor cutover and a standardized SLA addendum for Dedicated/Private customers.

If you want legal to review the DPA first, loop them in and we'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
